_comment: Ironické ilustrace dlaždic online rozcestníku. Vyrábí: node scripts/gen-irony-images.js --ui. Zobrazují se 56-72 px (hero 72, ostatní 56), takže JEDEN dominantní objekt a JEDEN vtip — vedlejší gagy se v té velikosti ztratí (viz CLAUDE.md, past s dlaždicí Asie). Dlaždice sekcí (section-*) sem přibyly 2026-08-30 spolu se sekcemi Symboly a Zajímavosti. Utility (Žebříček/Přátelé/Účet) ilustraci NEMAJÍ schválně: mají SVG ikony, aby nesoupeřily s hraním.
mode-online: A cheerful player sits at a small desk in a warm cosy room, leaning back with a delighted grin and hands raised in a shrug of mock helplessness, while four or five small figures from all over the world lean in through the window beside them, waving, grinning and elbowing each other for a better spot, far too many of them for the space, all impatient for their turn to play. One clear focal point: the player and the crowd together at the centre, everything else quiet and subordinate.
zk-live: A vintage painted globe on its little wooden stand, with a single oversized boxing glove bursting straight out of the Pacific on a long coiled spring, punching towards the viewer. Plain soft background, nothing else competing for attention.
zk-daily: A hand fills the entire frame holding a neat fan of exactly five identical playing cards, their faces entirely blank and empty, held with the confidence of someone who has not yet looked at them. Plain soft background, nothing else competing for attention.
zk-link: A corked glass bottle fills the entire frame in close-up, tilted and half afloat, with a tightly rolled and completely blank slip of paper sealed inside it. Plain soft background, nothing else competing for attention.
zk-tourney: A golden trophy cup fills the entire frame in close-up, tipped over at an angle, with a fine stream of hourglass sand pouring out of its bowl into a small heap below. Plain soft background, nothing else competing for attention.
auth-hero: A giant globe fills the entire frame in close-up, its curved surface a plain painted world map with no country names or labels. A small group of people are having a cosy picnic scattered across its rounded top on a checkered blanket, a teacup tilting on its saucer and a plate of food sliding gently toward the equator. Plain soft background, nothing else competing for attention.
